name: Email Verification Resend Throttled
summary: An unverified durable user receives a verification code and immediately requests another one while resend cooldown is active; no replacement proof is issued and the code-entry UI shows the throttled presentation state.
finalOutcome: Email ownership remains unverified, the current verification proof remains valid, no replacement proof is issued, and the user sees the resend-throttled presentation state.

sourceReferences.note: Cooldown is modeled as one representative behavior rather than enumerating every timing combination.
